findings.title: Regression test does not wait for the reader thread before asserting
findings.body: The test creates a raw reader thread at line 139 but never retains or joins it. After setting deletedAll to true, the main thread immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty at this line. Any in-flight groups() call that began before deletedAll was set can still fail after the assertion and add an exception too late, so the test can pass even if the NPE it is meant to catch occurs. Retain the thread and join it with a timeout before asserting, or use an ExecutorService/Future so the read is complete before the assertion.

findings.title: Other getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference a null model supplier
findings.body: The PR fixes getSubGroupsCount by checking modelSupplier.get() for null (line 274), but the three getSubGroupsStream overloads at lines 256, 262, and 268 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. Under the same concurrent group deletion that causes the original NPE, modelSupplier.get() can return null and these methods will still throw NPE. Use the same null-handling strategy, or a shared helper, so all concurrent access paths are covered.
